author: Inside Edition
description: The Lindsay Clancy trial has made postpartum psychosis a buzz phrase with scant real meaning. But it has a great deal of meaning to mothers who’ve heard voices, seen things that weren’t there and absolutely believed those things were real. "What do you say to people? 'I'm seeing and hearing stuff all the time?’ You sound crazy. I would have never known, had someone not diagnosed me," says Kathryn Myers. Mothers who've come out the other side of postpartum psychosis, and those who treat them, tell Inside Edition Digital’s Deborah Hastings the dangerous condition is greatly misunderstood.
title: Lindsay Clancy Trial Drags Postpartum Psychosis Into The Light
